'rva' is relative to 'module'; 'chain' = pointer offsets applied after reading the root (CE/LiveSplit style: read [base+rva], then for each offset but the last, read [p+off]; the last offset is added). 'deref_root': false = the root is a static struct, so the offsets are added without dereferencing. 'sig' = byte signature verified at startup (item 2); 'ghidra' = where it was confirmed.
